text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text: Daddy, that Umamusume is so fast!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Zooming right along~! Look, that's amazing-!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the cheers of a diverse crowd of racing fans,
I watch Fenomeno run her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno's extension is flawless.
Running with a full-body stride, her form is absolutely beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(I shall use this as my stepping stone—!
Starting with this debut...!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Be a role model for the children!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Daaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Is there any Umamusume who can catch the leader?!
Here they come, launching into their final spurts—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: They're crossing the finish liiiiine now!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I shout my heartfelt feelings from the stands.
With running like this, she will undoubtedly become the idol of children everywhere—!

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa--!!??

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: That scream just now... Was it from the infield!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Kh, what a strong scent of trouble!
This officer is coming to the rescue—!!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
"Gyaaaaaa!"
"Nooooo!"
"Stay awaaay~~~!"

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text:
That scary lady has red eyes~~!
She looks like a ghost~~!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... The children, because of me...
It's because of my immaturity that I traumatized them...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Fenomeno worked too hard
and her eyes became bloodshot for a bit.
choice_data_list: Can I take a look to see if the redness in your eyes has gone down?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, thanks to keeping it iced the whole time,
her eye seems to have gone back to its normal color, but...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: It's all my fault...! The child... the child is...!
choice_data_list: It's okay, we'll make up for it next time!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, —yes!
I will make up for thiiis!!

text_block_list.name: Golshi & Nakayama
text_block_list.text:
“...Heh...
...Heheheh...”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Dwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You really botched it, Meno.
Can't tell if you're just clumsy or actually got something going for ya...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Golshi.
...They're here. Your classmates from the same draft year.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Was it worth the wait?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hmph...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Bobombo.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the debut race. Race reviews
about the Umamusume began appearing, mainly in weekly magazines.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Among them is also
that pathetic sight of mine—)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(...No, I must not look away!
An ally of justice must reflect upon their failures!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Aargh, to hell with it!!

text_block_list.name: Article
text_block_list.text:
"The Unpredictable Umamusume, Gold Ship!
Sensational Debut!!"

text_block_list.name: Article
text_block_list.text:
"Phenomenal Junior-class course record!
Is the secret... the moonwalk!?"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Article
text_block_list.text:
"An unflinching performance in the paddock.
What was the reason behind her first-place victory!?"

text_block_list.name: Expert's Opinion
text_block_list.text: “It must have been a whim.”

text_block_list.name: Article
text_block_list.text:
"Even after the winning run,
she jumped into the stands and went wild!"

text_block_list.name: Expert's Opinion
text_block_list.text: "She was remarkably energetic."

text_block_list.name: Article
text_block_list.text:
"The kids who came to watch were super thrilled too!
Sunglasses completely sold out because of all the kids copying her!"

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
"The race was so much fun!"
"I love Gold Ship~"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: "Among the other Umamusume debuting this year, there is even one whose eyes turned bloodshot after crossing the finish line..."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: "With Gold Ship leading the charge, drawing attention as... a chaotic generation..."

text_block_list.name: Child at the Bookstore A
text_block_list.text:
Look, Mom!
Watch this, I'm Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Child at the Bookstore B
text_block_list.text:
Golshi is in this book!
Daddy, buy it for me!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Wh-Wh-Wh...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: GYAAAAAAAH?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On this day, Fenomeno rushed into the Trainer's Office without even knocking.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss! It's an emergency!
We have a situation on our hands!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Golshi-san was! Blatantly ignoring every single rule
in the student handbook! At the racetrack's! Paddock!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“—...And to top it off, they even wrote that I'm one
of Golshi-san's accomplices!”
choice_data_list: But Meno and Gold Ship are totally different!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: That is correct! Incorrect common knowledge is already spreading! If this trend floods the world...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
The children might start seeing
this chaos as a model to follow...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
My failure was completely unacceptable!
If only I had performed properly, I could have at least put the brakes on things!!
choice_data_list: (...Meno's shouldering all the blame by herself!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ngh— I have to go tell those children
what true righteousness is right now...!!
choice_data_list: Got it, Meno! Let's enter a G1 next!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: "A GⅠ...?! Does that mean—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
GⅠ refers to the highest tier of races
among all Umamusume competitions.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Entrants need proven ability and track records...
which also means fan anticipation is incredibly high.
choice_data_list: And you'll share your justice with everyone!
And I'll share your justice with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
choice_data_list: You can't lose to Gold Ship, Meno!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes, I have no intention of backing down either!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Please, let me change this reality where I can't even
live up to the model standard, together with you!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's make sure everyone gets to know Meno properly!
Yeah, let's make sure everyone gets to know Meno properly!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes! In that case, among the eligible GⅠ races,
the one that best suits my aptitudes would be...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
We are considering the middle-distance GⅠ, the Hopeful Stakes.
What do you think?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno brought up the stage that crowns the Junior Class Champion.
A medium-distance race held at Nakayama Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We look at each other and fire ourselves up.
All to change everyone's impression of her at the Hopeful Stakes!
